title: Apple Says iCloud+ Plans Will Not Include Increased Siri AI Usage in UK
excerpt: Apple on Monday announced that it is implementing daily usage limits on Siri AI and select other Apple Intelligence features that rely on...
content_html:
Tuesday November 17, 2026 7:07 am PST by Joe Rossignol

Apple on Monday announced that it is implementing daily usage limits on Siri AI and select other Apple Intelligence features that rely on "powerful server models" starting with iOS 27.3 and corresponding software updates, but increased access will be included with most iCloud+ plans at no additional cost in most countries, with one notable exception.


In a support document, Apple said increased access to these features with most iCloud+ plans will not be available in the UK. It is unclear if this means Brits will have no way of getting around the daily usage limits or if Apple plans to charge a separate fee for increased access to the features in the country. We have reached out to Apple for comment.

The limits will apply to features such as Siri AI, Image Playground, options like Clean Up and Extend in the Photos app, generating shortcuts with natural language in the Shortcuts app, and more. Apple says the limits may vary by feature category, request complexity, system demand, system policies, and other factors.

An overview of iCloud+ pricing in the U.S. and increased usage of Siri AI and select other Apple Intelligence features included with each plan:

  • 5GB (free): Standard limit
  • 50GB ($0.99/month): Standard limit
  • 200GB ($2.99/month): Up to 2× the standard limit
  • 2TB ($9.99/month): Up to 5×
  • 6TB ($29.99/month): Up to 10×
  • 12TB ($59.99/month): Up to 20×

iOS 27.3 is currently in beta. The update is expected to be released in December. For more details, read our previous coverage and Apple's support document.
